name: genpark-hubx-multimodal-mobile-agent-mcp
description: Native Model Context Protocol (MCP) server exposing HubX's mobile-first multimodal toolchain: vision diagnostics, voice transcription, photo-realistic generation, and spatial design.
author: AlphaPark

tools.name: hubx_vision_diagnose
tools.description: Execute botanical identification or meal macro recognition on visual inputs.

tools.name: hubx_speech_transcribe
tools.description: Transcribe audio stream and distill meeting key points (NoteAI).

tools.name: hubx_multimodal_generate
tools.description: Generate photorealistic portraits or spatial interior restyling concepts.

tools.name: hubx_language_coach
tools.description: Evaluate user pronunciation and grammar in real-time interactive dialogue.

tools.name: run_benchmark_multimodal_tools
tools.description: Benchmark multimodal processing latency and classification precision.
